title: Data model
description: The shape of packages/naive/src/records/data-model.json (EE-018): every record type of the ecosystem, the layer that owns it, its schema, where its records live and what each references. packages/naive/src/checks/check-data-model.mjs checks it against the repository.

settles.description: How a projected record type is scored (autoresearch design, everything-ecosystem docs/design/AUTORESEARCH_RECORDS_2026-11-06.md, "The metric"): only a type with writer projection may carry it. The prediction is the record a recipe renders as of t; the settled record is what people and producers established about valid times up to t once the horizon passed. Settled loss is the weighted mean over (record, as-of point) rows of each field's loss, and a forecast field is scored by Brier against whether its resolving event arrived within its window. A null record loses every field. packages/naive/src/checks/check-data-model.mjs checks that each field named is a top-level property of the type's schema. The scorers are build plan item 5, not built

horizon.description: How long after an as-of point its outcome settles

cadence.description: The spacing of as-of points a plan draws

fn.description: The closed catalog. exact: 0 when equal, else 1. set-jaccard: 1 minus the Jaccard index of two lists taken as sets (by each entry's signal when entries carry one). abs-scaled: the absolute difference over scale, capped at 1

scale.description: abs-scaled only: the difference that costs a whole loss

weight.description: The field's weight in the record's loss; 1 when left out

loss.description: A loss per scored field, keyed by the field's name

resolved_by.description: What settles the forecast: a signal of one of these types about the subject from a producer a second producer confirmed, or from a person; or a person deciding or dismissing the decision the record proposed. An agent's write never resolves one

window.description: How long after the as-of point the resolving event may arrive

forecasts.description: Forecast fields, each a probability from 0 to 1 in the record, keyed by the field's name. The forecast set is fixed, so a recipe that leaves one out still pays for every confirmed event

min_counts.description: The fewest scored rows each window needs before a plan may be made

kind.description: What a host does with the file when it commits a venture's working copy. record (the default): written whole through the store. log: append-only, so a commit may only add lines at the end. derived: a cache Naive rebuilds, which a host may keep or drop

confidential.description: Records an app marks confidential (such as Mentura's research records, added through naive.data-model.json): checked like any other, left out of generated docs

layer.description: The owning layer, or system for records every layer shares

level.description: method: this repo's own records; workspace: one per builder; venture: inside a venture folder

schema.description: Path to the schema that governs it, or null when it has none yet

generator.description: EE-099: the record generator beside the schema; it describes what to ask and drafts one record that passes the schema, and stores nothing itself

form.description: Default json. json-list: the file holds a list of records. json-lines: one record per line, append-only. typescript: a TypeScript module (a recipe, <pattern>.recipe.ts); the schema, when there is one, governs the data the module exports, not the file, so packages/naive/src/records/validate.mjs does not read it

writer.description: Who may write records of this type. any (the default): whoever the gate and decision rights allow. projection: only the signal projector (signal library design); the router refuses every other actor, a person included, before the schema (writerRule in packages/naive/src/engine/gate.mjs). person: only a person (autoresearch design, a function's research program); the router refuses every agent, whatever its role, and the projector, before the schema, and a person's write lands live

view_of.description: This record type is a view of part of another type's file. Files are validated and owned by that type; the view has its own route and schema for what may be written.

decision_class.description: The decision class (packages/naive/template/governance/decision-rights.json) a write of this record is. When the venture's decision rights put the class at escalate or recommend-approve, an agent's write through the router is held as a draft for a person to accept (EE-032)

contains.description: Record types that live inside this one's folder

to.description: A record type id, or a parenthesised name for a non-record target

checked_by.description: The check that resolves this reference, or null when nothing does yet

files.description: Venture files no record type covers, each with its kind, so a host knows how to commit every file in a venture folder (hosted working copy design, section 2). packages/naive/src/records/index.mjs pathKind reads them together with the record types

path.description: A glob inside any venture folder, written with the instance/**/ prefix venture-level record paths carry
